parent_objective: run neighbor viability calibration proposal smoke without preflight or replay
blocked_by: neighbor viability calibration generator has not yet been run on M1481 artifacts

public_gates: M1485 must run proposal generation only
M1485 must not run preflight replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1485 must report selected rows source-group counts viability-class counts source diversity duplicate keys and guardrails
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat proposal counts as replay evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs neighbor viability calibration generator on M1481 artifacts to test whether calibrated source-diverse candidates exist before preflight or replay
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: proposal smoke only; no preflight, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if neighbor_source selected rows are zero
stop if selected candidates collapse to one seed or capability pair
stop if duplicate neighbor viability keys remain
stop if any preflight replay training PPO promotion or corpus export starts
fallback_plan: route to proposal smoke audit if calibrated neighbor candidates are missing
route to preflight design if calibrated neighbor candidates are viable
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1484 implemented neighbor viability calibration generator

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up preflight design or proposal audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: proposal smoke completed or failed clearly
selected source diversity and duplicate-key counts are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1485 is proposal-only and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future calibrated replay must test neighbor-source rows under normal history, warmup interventions, reset hidden, and zero-current controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1481 source-diverse pressure replay and M1484 calibration generator.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If proposal smoke cannot produce calibrated source-diverse candidates, route to audit or synthesis rather than corpus export.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The neighbor viability calibration generator can produce a calibrated source-diverse candidate pool from M1481 artifacts without replay or training.
failure_criteria: run starts preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1485 passes if neighbor viability proposal generation produces nonempty neighbor-source candidates with no duplicate keys and no preflight or replay.
